description: Multiple armored vehicles and technicals with mounted weapons observed. Troops dismounting and taking cover behind berms. Troop movement and defensive posturing detected.
Troops advancing from cover, moving in squad formation toward right side of frame. Technical vehicle remains in support position. Increased infantry maneuver.
Troops consolidating at new cover positions. Technical vehicle with mounted weapon advancing to new location. Infantry forming small groups behind berms.
Technical vehicle halts, providing overwatch. Troops establish positions behind multiple berms and sandbags, forming defensive clusters.
Troops continue to reinforce defensive positions. Technical vehicle stationary, gunner remains alert. One troop moving between positions.
Troops fully established in defensive clusters behind berms. One individual moving between positions, no visible enemy contact.
Multiple infantry squads observed in dispersed positions, some using sandbag cover, one individual advancing toward the berm. No vehicles in immediate proximity.
Infantry squad advancing in tactical file formation up a berm, weapons at the ready. No hostile vehicles detected.
Squad continues movement up berm, maintaining spacing and tactical posture. No change in vehicle presence.
Squad nearing crest of berm, weapons raised, preparing to take covered positions. No visible enemy contact.
Squad reaching cover at berm crest, preparing to establish firing positions. Burned-out vehicle and debris visible ahead.
Squad in covered firing positions behind berm, weapons aimed forward. No enemy forces or vehicles detected in immediate area.
